```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
d      <- params$data
study  <- params$study
pages  <- params$pages
if (is.null(pages)) pages <- unique(as.character(d$page))
SHORT <- c("Genomic Pipeline"="GlobALL Pipeline","Phenotype Data"="Phenotype Data",
           "Epi Data"="Epi Data","IARC DCC Transfer"="IARC DCC")
disp <- function(p) if (!is.na(SHORT[p])) unname(SHORT[p]) else p
```

# `r study`

Generated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` from the GlobALL dashboard.

```{r results='asis'}
if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) {
  cat("No records found for this study.\n\n")
} else {
  for (pg in pages) {
    dp <- d[d$page == pg, ]
    
    # 🛡️ SAFETY FIX: Only sort if the data frame actually has rows and the column exists!
    if (nrow(dp) > 0 && "col_order" %in% names(dp)) {
      dp <- dp[order(dp$col_order), ]
    }
    
    cat("\n## ", disp(pg), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!nrow(dp)) { cat("*No record for this study in this tab.*\n\n"); next }
    
    meta <- c(unique(dp$country[nzchar(dp$country)]),
              unique(dp$institution[nzchar(dp$institution)]))
    if (length(meta)) cat("*", paste(meta, collapse = " \u00b7 "), "*\n\n", sep = "")
    
    print(kable(data.frame(Milestone = dp$milestone, Status = dp$status),
                row.names = FALSE))
    
    notes <- unique(dp$notes[nzchar(dp$notes)])
    if (length(notes)) cat("\n\n**Notes:** ", paste(notes, collapse = "; "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

---

<small>Status reflects what is currently entered in clic_data.xlsx; blank/Unknown values are awaiting confirmation.</small>
